title: 否定转移与简化

examples.en: I don't think he is right.
I don't know what to do.

guess.question: 想说“我认为他不会来”，英语该怎么说？

options.text: I don't think he will come.——否定放在主句上
options.feedback: 对！think / believe 这类词要把否定提到前面，这叫否定转移。
不对——英语习惯把否定放在 think 前面，说成 I don't think…
不对——这里说的是将来的事，且否定位置不对。

rule.rule: think / believe / suppose 后接从句时，否定要转移到主句；当从句主语与主句主语一致时，从句可以简化成“疑问词 + to do”
rule.formula: ① 否定转移：I don't think he is right.（不说 I think he isn't right.）　② 简化：I don't know what I should do. → I don't know what to do.　③ 反意疑问句看从句：I don't think he is right, is he?

anchors.en: I don't think he will come tomorrow.
anchors.note: 否定在主句 think 上

anchors.en: I don't know how to get there.
anchors.note: 从句简化成 how to get

trap.wrong: I think he won't come to the party.
trap.right: I don't think he will come to the party.
trap.why: think 引导的从句，否定要转移到主句。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——think 的否定往前挪；主语相同时可以把从句缩成“疑问词 + to do”。

check.stem: I ____ think he ____ right. Let me check it again.

options.distractor: 否定已转移，从句里不能再否定
think 是实义动词，用 don't 否定

check.explanation: 否定转移：I don't think he is right。

check.stem: “I don't know what I should do.” 可以简化成 ____.

options.text: I don't know what to do
I don't know how to do

options.text: I don't know to do what

check.explanation: 简化成“疑问词 + to do”：what to do。
